title: Hydrophobic alkyl-linked base-modified pyrimidine and 7-deazapurine 2′-deoxyribonucleoside phosphoramidites: synthesis and application in solid-phase synthesis of modified and hypermodified oligonucleotides
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48556-48565
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06147D, Paper
Open Access

Ivana Jestřábová, Lucie Bednárová, Lenka Poštová Slavětínská, Michal Hocek
Four nucleoside phosphoramidites bearing aliphatic or aromatic groups linked through flexible alkyl tether were synthesized and used for solid-phase oligonucleotide synthesis and for study of stability of duplexes.
